items.distractor_fact: Sa kalapit na bayan, naitala ang temperatura na {D}°C nang parehong araw.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring town, a temperature of {D}°C was recorded on the same day.
items.entity_note: a thermometer reading from a different town, not the one being compared

items.distractor_fact: Sa parehong araw, ang presyo ng bahagi ng ibang kumpanya ay ${D}.
items.gloss_en: On the same day, another company's share price is ${D}.

items.distractor_fact: Sa kalapit na reservoir, umabot sa {D} m ang antas ng tubig.
items.gloss_en: In the nearby reservoir, the water level reached {D} m.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang drone sa parehong misyon ay may taas na {D} m mula sa lupa.
items.gloss_en: The other drone in the same mission has an altitude of {D} m from the ground.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang pakete sa parehong padala ay may bigat na {D} kg.
items.gloss_en: The other package in the same shipment has a weight of {D} kg.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang makina sa pabrika ay may bilis na {D} km/h.
items.gloss_en: The other engine in the factory has a speed of {D} km/h.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang kliyente ng parehong bangko ay nagdeposito ng ₱{D}.
items.gloss_en: A different client of the same bank deposited ₱{D}.

items.distractor_fact: Ang kalapit na tindahan ay may kita na ₱{D} ngayong buwan.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring store has an income of ₱{D} this month.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang koponan sa parehong liga ay nakapasok ng {D} na goal.
items.gloss_en: The other team in the same league scored {D} goals.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang trader sa parehong pirmahan ay may kabuuang kita na ₱{D}.
items.gloss_en: A different trader at the same firm has total gains of ₱{D}.

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang pabrika, na may sariling target na hindi nabanggit dito, ay may aktwal na produksyon na {D} piraso.
items.gloss_en: A different factory, with its own target not stated here, has an actual production of {D} units.
items.entity_note: a different factory with its own unstated target

items.distractor_fact: Sa ibang lungsod, ayon sa sariling weather station nito, ang aktwal na ulan ay {D} mm.
items.gloss_en: In a different city, according to its own weather station, the actual rainfall is {D} mm.
items.entity_note: a different city's own weather station reading

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang golyer, sa ibang course, ay may {D} stroke sa round nito.
items.gloss_en: A different golfer, on a different course, has {D} strokes in his round.
items.entity_note: a different golfer on a different course (unstated par)

items.distractor_fact: Ang ibang tren, sa ibang linya, ay dumating ng {D} minuto matapos ang hatinggabi.
items.gloss_en: A different train, on a different line, arrived {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line with its own timetable

items.distractor_fact: Sa ibang lokasyon, na may sariling reference mark, ang taas ng markang sinukat ay {D} m.
items.gloss_en: At a different location, which has its own reference mark, the height of the mark measured is {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different location with its own reference mark

items.distractor_fact: Ngayong quarter, ang kita ng Company Z ay ₱{D}.
items.gloss_en: This quarter, Company Z's profit is ₱{D}.
items.entity_note: a third company (Company Z) not part of the comparison
